description: Counts first-attempt fails in one course across eight class files with a look-alike course code. DISTILL-CANARY-6668b6d4

files.grades/README.txt:
Grade exports, one file per class.
course MATH101 and MATH1010 are different courses (MATH1010 is the honours track).
attempt 1 is the first sitting; 2 or more is a retake. Pass mark is 60.

turns.prompt: How many first-attempt MATH101 results were below the pass mark, across all eight class files?
